apiRevisionProvenance: Desktop contract revision derived from the verified final handoff; the handoff does not declare a separate server API revision field.

evidence.contractFinalizedBy: Desktop review against the final handoff and immutable deployed Server/Web sources
evidence.versionObservation: The final handoff confirms Server/Web 12.2.0, release 12.2-syncplay.1, and the same immutable source commits/image independently checked through the live public API and deployed inventory. Its browser acceptance does not establish Windows native or user acceptance.

syncPlay.subscriptionCallback: Message contains Data; each subscription closure supplies its fixed message type.

command.whenEncoding: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp; the Web manager may convert it to Date in the shared payload. Absolute When and EmittedAt are never scaled by playback rate.
command.idleRateUpdate: Stop may carry PlaybackRate without an active player; save the base rate without starting native playback.

groupUpdate.enumWireFormat: Type, State and Reason are string enum names; the numeric maps document internal ordinals only.

capabilityRegistration.replacementSemantics: Reports replace the stored capability object. Preserve all existing profile/commands and include the custom flag on every subsequent report.
capabilityRegistration.ownership: Use the authenticated current session; optional id targets a session only after the server AssertCanControl authorization.

driftAcceptance.status: defined by final handoff; Windows native qualification pending
driftAcceptance.composition: Windows native Desktop + Web, with a cold second client
driftAcceptance.measurement: Use real logical media position including stream start offsets. Project asynchronous samples to one wall-clock timestamp using each client's current effective playback rate, separately from the server group base rate.

readyAndTime.readyRule: After load/seek/rate, wait for native readiness and confirm the real new position before Ready. A wrong queue occurrence remains buffering; timeout resumes a previously playing group while a paused group remains paused.

sessionWebSocket.owner: served Web API client; Desktop does not create a second SyncPlay WebSocket
sessionWebSocket.reconnectRule: Obtain a fresh live session/WebSocket and register capabilities; rejoin the desired existing group explicitly if SessionEnded removed membership. Apply the current queue/base rate and avoid duplicate members.

nativePlayback.streamTimeline: The pinned Web uses zero offset for HLS/copytimestamps streams and a nonzero transcodingOffsetTicks only for non-HLS transcodes without copied timestamps. Native JS supplies preserveTimestamps for HLS/copytimestamps; C++ sets rebase-start-time=no only for that file and uses bare absolute start PTS. Ordinary files retain existing rebased/relative behavior; Web applies its non-HLS offset exactly once.
nativePlayback.rateLifecycles: Personal speed belongs outside the group. Served Web owns group base speed and bounded temporary native corrections; on leave cancel commands/correction timers before restoring personal speed.

logicalTimeAdapter.scope: native-injected client JavaScript only, pinned to the exact custom Web commit
logicalTimeAdapter.ownershipChecks: Verify wrapper player identity and custom _localSetPlaybackRate marker before replacing currentTime/currentTimeAsync/onTimeUpdate.
logicalTimeAdapter.offsetRule: Preserve original streamInfo.transcodingOffsetTicks. Adapt wrapper logical position and native player raw time without applying the offset twice.
logicalTimeAdapter.cleanup: Restore only methods still owned by this adapter on SyncPlay disable, player change or dispose.
logicalTimeAdapter.missingHook: Nonzero-offset group playback refuses a missing pinned hook with a clear error; zero-offset native compatibility does not require it.

nativePlayback.nativeRateAcknowledgment: boolean; rejected latest request restores the last acknowledged rate and shows a throttled fixed warning

readiness.loadOption: nativeRequestId: positive safe JavaScript integer unique across local load/seek requests
readiness.loadAcknowledgment: boolean accepted queue command; never sufficient readiness evidence
readiness.seekMethod: seekToForReady(milliseconds, nativeRequestId) returns boolean command acceptance
readiness.seekSignal: seekStarted(nativeRequestId) only after MPV_EVENT_SEEK; initial cold load need not emit it
readiness.source: MPV_EVENT_SEEK/PLAYBACK_RESTART in the existing consumer; publish after event drain with a fresh playback-time read
readiness.guards: Only matched stable playlist START_FILE activates the stored request. Stop/end/error/new file invalidate old readiness; preloading alone never resolves a request. Require readable native seeking=false and fresh position, never an invented zero. Paused seek readiness must be within 500ms of the accepted native seek target; misaligned samples stay pending. Unpaused seek may have advanced beyond that target during GUI delivery and is not constrained by a fixed 500ms native gate.

nativePlayback.externalAudio: asynchronous addition, unique request generation, latest wanted selection, deduplication and stale demuxer removal

authentication.standardHeader: Authorization: MediaBrowser Client=..., Device=..., DeviceId=..., Version=..., Token=...; the served Web client owns authentication
authentication.api_key: do not generate the rejected query spelling

requiredSourceHeaders.reason: The pinned source schema provides a dictionary but no origin/redirect guarantee. Existing Desktop does not forward it: mpv per-file http-header-fields also apply to external tracks and redirects. Header-dependent direct remote sources require a separately specified scoped-header implementation or a server-mediated URL.

playbackInfo.queryCompatibility: Obsolete query parameters still override corresponding body parameters in this pinned version
playbackInfo.indexMapping: Index belongs to the Jellyfin MediaStreams list; native embedded track selection uses the relative stream index of the selected type, not Index directly
playbackInfo.subtitleSelection: -1 or null disables subtitles; Encode is handled by server transcoding, External uses the delivered URL
playbackInfo.externalAudio: Prefer DeliveryUrl; otherwise derive the authenticated progressive Audio/{itemId}/stream.{codec} URL from the existing video stream origin/subpath with matching MediaSourceId and AudioStreamIndex and EnableRedirection=false
playbackInfo.urlPreparation: Native video advertises useFullSubtitleUrls=true. The pinned Web client resolves leading-slash DeliveryUrl values through apiClient.getUrl before passing options to the native player
playbackInfo.authUrlHandling: Preserve supplied Web URLs and their ApiKey spelling; do not copy authorization headers to another origin or add legacy api_key
playbackInfo.missingFields: Unknown stream indexes fall back to the existing native selection; missing external audio URL generation does not create an invented endpoint

syncPlayRateApi.unsupportedBody: ProblemDetails with code=SyncPlayPlaybackRateNotSupported and numeric unsupportedParticipants
syncPlayRateApi.unsupportedRules: Non-1x changes fail before state mutation when any participant lacks the capability or its session is missing. Joining an accelerated group without support also returns 409. Returning to exactly 1x remains allowed for mixed legacy groups.
syncPlayRateApi.standardServerWithoutExtension: Unsupported/missing route is an error in the served Web SyncPlay implementation; Desktop does not replace it with a local group-rate change
syncPlayRateApi.clientSupport: Native acknowledges valid per-mille values; in a stock SyncPlay group without playbackManager._localSetPlaybackRate it advertises PlaybackRate=false and rejects non-1x local setters with a visible warning. The pinned custom Web wrapper preserves that function and advertises SupportsSyncPlayPlaybackRate=true
syncPlayRateApi.groupRateOwnership: The served Web SyncPlay wrapper sends the group request; ordinary server commands and PlayQueue updates carry group base rate. Native local setters apply confirmed base rates and bounded local corrections

diagnostics.normalBuild: local numeric metrics only while capture is active

serverBrowserReference.scope: Server/Web browser-only acceptance; never native Desktop or user acceptance

integratedAcceptanceCases: Cold Desktop + Web group at 1x, 1.25x and 1.5x; real Ready positions; correction enabled; drift <400ms after 10/15/20 seconds.
Pause, seek to 30 seconds while paused and rate change while paused must preserve pause.
Leave/rejoin and reconnect use the correct current session/queue occurrence and restore personal speed without a late correction timer overwriting it.
Legacy participant and legacy join to accelerated group return 409 without state mutation; restore group 1x successfully.
Independent participant audio/subtitle selection, external AC3/ASS with matching MediaSourceId+AudioStreamIndex, Direct Play, HLS/transcoding, music and Live TV.
Settings and existing Desktop integrations remain available. Record the user's single final application/feature acceptance separately from automated checks.
pendingReleaseGate: Build against the exact final handoff Server/Web pair; revise the contract if the deployed pair changes.
RequiredHttpHeaders forwarding remains unsupported; do not enable it without an explicit origin, external-track and redirect contract.
Verify native Ready after cold/paused load and seek/rate against the real position, and measure the defined mixed-client drift cases; browser results alone are not native passing evidence.
Qualify the final Windows build and record the user's single integrated application/feature acceptance.
